original_requirement: After an exact PA strict-tool target observation, finish the current Provider boundary and evidence receipt, then stop before every later credential lookup, Provider-client construction, budget reservation, network dispatch or paid call without changing production Runtime behavior.
operational_definition: Only the PA Canary profile installs a first-exact-target-wins latch. The current boundary completes; the next PreflightGatedGateway dispatch raises a typed Canary-only cancellation before authorization, reservation or delegate invocation. C0B and production paths do not install the latch.
forbidden_narrowing: Gateway tool-shape acceptance alone cannot be described as Whole receipt closure.
A goal stop cannot be counted as workflow terminal, Provider failure, Runtime defect, production incident or budget exhaustion.
The current target boundary cannot be interrupted before its Provider receipt and business result or exception are retained.
Trace sink or sidecar write failure cannot reopen Provider dispatch.
C0B Smoke and Budget Counterfactual cannot inherit the PA goal-stop behavior.
closed_world_justification: The external-action boundary is the finite Canary PreflightGatedGateway. All Canary model dispatch methods converge on _dispatch; the PA-only latch is checked under one dispatch lock before authorization/reservation/delegate, while profiles without the stop condition receive no latch.

constraint_traceability.implementation: ObservationGoalLatch plus the gateway-local goal dispatch lock and pre-authorization checks.
constraint_traceability.evidence: Tests separately assert target completion, boundary receipt persistence, ordinal 11 block, zero post-goal credential/client/network/paid deltas, and unchanged reservation count.

constraint_traceability.requirement: First exact target wins across duplicates, concurrent next dispatch, trace failure, cancellation and later exceptions.
constraint_traceability.implementation: Thread-safe idempotent latch, atomic hash-only sidecar replacement, trace interception before best-effort append, and cancellation-shaped typed stop.
constraint_traceability.evidence: Duplicate, concurrent dispatch, sink failure, target-boundary exception, process exception and launcher-cancellation tests pass.

constraint_traceability.requirement: C0B, Budget Counterfactual and live business artifacts remain unchanged.
constraint_traceability.implementation: Latch construction is conditional on the PA stop condition; PA output-budget-lineage remains false and forbidden; no production path is changed.
constraint_traceability.evidence: Profile isolation and live-tree parity tests pass; complete Canary suite passes.

constraint_traceability.implementation: Two sanitized V1 diagnostic artifacts preserve exact hashes and explicit unknown/unverifiable fields.

why_previous_tests_missed: Prior tests verified that the target could be observed and summarized after workflow completion, but no test asserted an in-flight observer-to-next-dispatch latch or post-target external-action deltas.

NOVEL_PA_OUTPUT_BUDGET_LINEAGE_V1 remains false and is still in forbidden_feature_flags.
No production source changed; the focused live-tree parity characterization remains exact.
